title: fix(pm): the four blocker readers say merged for a PR target, closed unmerged for an abandoned one, closed for an issue
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D9jGmwwyTkCF9iu11q2k3eK)_

Fixes #28033

## What changes

Wording only, in the four readers the card names. No verdict moves and no gate is added.

1. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` :85, flag two. 「目标已关闭」 → 「目标已关单(PR 则已合并;关而未合并不算)」. The line now says what H19 fires on: an issue closed, a PR merged, never a PR closed unmerged. In-line, line count 245 → 245, 100 bytes (ceiling 120).
2. `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` `h28StaleBodyBlockerLine`. The spent body targets are no longer all called `CLOSED`: the row says `target(s) no longer OPEN` and names each the way `namedTargets` renders it (`closed`, or `closed UNMERGED` for an abandoned PR, which it says released nothing while the body line is spent either way). The `spent` filter is unchanged, so the row fires exactly where it did.
3. `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` `proseBlockerClause`, the mixed branch. Each count is named only when non-zero, so an abandoned PR beside an unresolved target reads `None of them has released — 1 closed UNMERGED (which withholds), 1 could not be resolved from this install` instead of opening with `0 still read OPEN`.
4. `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs`. `judgeCardBlock` carries `merged: true` on a closed PR row whose `pull_request.merged_at` is set; `renderBlockNote` renders that row `(merged <date>)` and its headline says `closed (a PR: merged)`; `targetReading` logs it as `merged`. `staleBlockVerdict` is untouched.

Pins: six added to the existing H4 prose PR and H28 lines of `check-half-states --self-test` (5105 → 5111 cases), and the merged-PR case of `scheduled-full-run --self-test` now checks the note and the log name the merge. The optional `platform-readings.md` measured-leg line was not added: the file sits at its 458-line ceiling with no headroom, so it would have cost a line elsewhere.

## Why

After PR #28031 a `Blocked-by:` PR target releases on merged and a PR closed unmerged releases nothing, but these four places still said closed for every target. A seat reading them could take an abandoned PR for a released blocker. Follow-up card #28033 took review should-fixes 1, 2, 4 and 5 from that PR's contract review.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`: 5111 cases, exit 0.
- `node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test`: OK, exit 0.
- Two ablation legs, each restored to a byte-identical file: (A) the mixed branch always prints the open count → the two new H4 prose PR pins red; (B) `merged` never set in `judgeCardBlock` → the merged-PR case throws `the note does not name the merge`.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` (105 files clean), `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 54 families on the committed change; every one run locally after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` and reconciled with `--ran` (see the os-dev report on the card).
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the three paths: one `.claude/**` hit, Tier S; the two scripts are not on the register. The landing tier is read off the register at PR time.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:四处把 `Blocked-by:` 的 PR 目标说成「关闭」的读器改成「合并」:runbook 旗二、H28 的「已关」措辞、H4 混合行的 `0 still read OPEN`、定时全量运行备注里的 `(closed …)`。三个文件,规则文本行数不变(245)。
- 为什么改:PR #28031 之后规则是 PR 合并才放行、关而未合并不放,但这四处仍写「关闭」,席位可能把废弃 PR 当成已放行的阻塞。
- 风险与回滚:只改 report-only 行文,不动判定、不加门禁、不写标签;issue 目标仍是关闭即放行。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`scheduled-full-run.mjs` 的 `judgeCardBlock`(新增 `merged: true` 标记)和 `renderBlockNote`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`(5111 例)与 `node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test`,都 exit 0。
- 需要你做的:无。契约复审待席位完成(contract review owed),落地层级以登记册读数为准。

## Human Minimum

- [ ] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (no published package touched; `skip-changeset`)
- [ ] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
